summary_zh: 本页讲述了一只作恶多端的小老鼠因心脏病去世，临终前耳边响起的仍是《猫捉老鼠回旋曲》。右侧页面显示下一章节标题“一只既能寄信又能寄话的邮筒”。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 从前,有一只老蛤蟆。她已经很老很老了,大家都叫她蛤蟆奶奶。蛤蟆奶奶独自住在一棵老柳树的边上。蛤蟆奶奶的儿子出门去了很远的地方,好久没有回来了。蛤蟆奶奶很想念儿子,她很想给儿子寄封信,可是她不会写字。
page_text_en: Long ago, there was an old toad. She was very, very old, and everyone called her Grandma Toad. Grandma Toad lived alone by an old willow tree. Grandma Toad's son had gone far away and hadn't returned for a long time. Grandma Toad missed her son very much. She wanted to send him a letter, but she couldn't write.
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事的主角——年迈的蛤蟆奶奶，她独自住在老柳树旁，因儿子远行未归而思念他，但因不会写字而无法寄信。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
那天，蛤蟆奶奶出门，她走过一个
看上去挺漂亮的绿色邮筒，她又想起
了儿子，就对邮筒说了三遍：“邮筒，邮
筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”
谁知道，这时候邮筒里躲着一只小
青蛙。
原来，小青蛙和小刺猬在玩捉迷
藏游戏。小青蛙为了不让小刺猬捉不到
自己，他一使劲跳到了邮筒顶上，然
后再从顶上爬到下面的投递口，向投
递口里轻轻一跳，就进了邮筒。
小青蛙躲在暗暗的、暖暖的邮筒
里，小刺猬怎么也找不到他。
小青蛙躲着躲着就睡
着了。
page_text_en:
That day, Grandma Toad went out. She walked past a green mailbox that looked quite nice. She thought of her son again and said to the mailbox three times: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"

Who knew, at that moment, a little frog was hiding inside the mailbox.

Originally, the little frog and the little hedgehog were playing hide-and-seek. To make sure the little hedgehog couldn't find him, the frog jumped hard onto the top of the mailbox, then climbed down to the mail slot, and with a light jump into the slot, he entered the mailbox.

The little frog hid in the dark, warm mailbox, and the little hedgehog couldn't find him at all.

The little frog, hiding and hiding, fell asleep.
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶想给儿子寄话，却不知邮筒里正藏着一只玩捉迷藏的小青蛙，它躲进邮筒后不知不觉睡着了。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
当蛤蟆奶奶说第一遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，小青蛙被惊醒了；当蛤蟆奶奶说第二遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，这让小青蛙听清了蛤蟆奶奶的请求；
当蛤蟆奶奶说第三遍“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗”，小青蛙想起，他身上正带着笔和纸，甚至还有一张邮票呢。
page_text_en:
When Grandma Toad said for the first time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', the little frog was startled awake; when Grandma Toad said for the second time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', this made the little frog understand Grandma Toad's request;
When Grandma Toad said for the third time, 'Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?', the little frog remembered, he was carrying a pen and paper, and even had a postage stamp.
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶三次请求邮筒帮忙寄话给儿子，小青蛙从最初的惊醒到听清请求，最后想起自己身上带着笔、纸和邮票，准备帮忙。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙就在邮筒里大声回答：
“当然可以，要寄什么话请说吧！”
这话把蛤蟆奶奶吓了一大跳，但她
好高兴，她把要对儿子说的话说了一遍。躲在邮筒里的小青蛙借着从投递
口射进来的一点亮光，把蛤蟆奶奶的话全记下来了。

蛤蟆奶奶
说完儿子的地址，就回家了。
小青蛙在
信封上写下地址，贴上邮票，
他把信留在邮筒里，自己使劲
一跳，抓住了
投递口，爬了出来。
page_text_en:
The little frog answered loudly from inside the mailbox:
"Of course! Just tell me what message you'd like to send!"
This startled Grandma Toad greatly, but she was also very happy. She repeated everything she wanted to say to her son. The little frog hiding in the mailbox, using the small beam of light coming through the mail slot, wrote down every word Grandma Toad said.

Grandma Toad
finished saying her son's address and went home.
The little frog
wrote the address on the envelope, stuck on the stamp,
left the letter in the mailbox, then jumped hard,
grasped the mail slot, and climbed out.
summary_zh: 小青蛙在邮筒里答应帮蛤蟆奶奶寄话给儿子，记下她的话后，写好信封并贴上邮票，最后从邮筒里爬了出来。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
邮筒外面的阳光真好。小青蛙
又爬上邮筒顶，他伸伸胳膊伸伸腿，
为自己做了一件挺有趣的事而高兴。
没隔多久，蛤蟆奶奶就收到了儿子
的回信。

儿子告诉蛤蟆奶奶，她寄来的信收到了。
蛤蟆奶奶心里很纳闷：“什么信啊，我寄的是话，他应该说，我寄的话收到了。”不过蛤蟆奶奶还是很高兴，
毕竟儿子知道了她想说的话，还给她回了信。
page_text_en:
The sunshine outside the mailbox was wonderful. The little frog climbed back up to the top of the mailbox, stretching his arms and legs, happy about doing something fun.

Not long after, Grandma Toad received a reply from her son.

Her son told Grandma Toad that he had received her letter.
Grandma Toad was puzzled: “What letter? I sent words, he should have said, ‘I received your words.’” But Grandma Toad was still very happy, after all, her son knew what she wanted to say, and even wrote back to her.
summary_zh: 小青蛙在邮筒顶上休息，不久后蛤蟆奶奶收到了儿子的回信。儿子告知信已收到，蛤蟆奶奶虽疑惑自己寄的是话而非信，但因儿子知晓心意并回信而感到高兴。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
过了一些日子，蛤蟆奶奶又想给儿子寄话了。她来到那个漂亮的绿色邮筒边，一连对着邮筒喊了三遍：“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”

过了好半天，也不见动静。蛤蟆奶奶又使劲喊了一遍：“邮筒，邮筒，我能给儿子寄几句话吗？”

这声音让小青蛙听到了，他跑过来说：“蛤蟆奶奶，邮筒只能寄信不能寄话的！”

蛤蟆奶奶不信，她说：“我上次就是在这邮筒里寄的话。”
page_text_en:
After some days, Grandma Toad wanted to send a message to her son again. She came to the beautiful green mailbox and called out three times: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"

After a long while, there was no response. Grandma Toad shouted again: "Mailbox, mailbox, can I send a few words to my son?"

This sound reached the little frog, who ran over and said: "Grandma Toad, mailboxes can only send letters, not messages!"

Grandma Toad didn't believe him. She said: "Last time, I sent a message right in this mailbox."
summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶再次想给儿子寄话，对着邮筒反复呼喊，但无人回应。小青蛙听到后跑出来解释邮筒只能寄信，蛤蟆奶奶则坚持说自己上次就是在这里寄过话。

title_zh: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒
title_en: 87: A Mailbox That Sends Letters and Messages
source_file: 87一只能寄信又能寄话的邮筒（7-10岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
小青蛙笑着
说：“上次能办到的事，这次不一定能办到。还是让我来帮您写信吧！”
小青蛙拿出笔和纸帮蛤蟆奶奶写信，蛤蟆奶奶说一句他就写一句，写完信贴上邮票，小青蛙把信投进邮筒，并对蛤蟆奶奶说：“等着你儿子给你回信吧！”

蛤蟆奶奶谢谢小青蛙，不过她还是抚摸着邮筒说：“我真想让邮筒再给我寄一次话，我想听听邮筒说话的好听声音。”
page_text_en:
The little frog smiled and said, “The thing that could be done last time may not be possible this time. Still, let me help you write a letter!”
The little frog took out a pen and paper to help Grandma Toad write a letter. Grandma Toad said one sentence, and he wrote it down. After finishing the letter, he put on a stamp, dropped the letter into the mailbox, and said to Grandma Toad, “Wait for your son to reply to you!”

Grandma Toad thanked the little frog, but she still stroked the mailbox and said, “I really want the mailbox to send me a message again. I want to hear the mailbox’s lovely voice.”
summary_zh: 小青蛙帮蛤蟆奶奶写信并寄出，蛤蟆奶奶收到儿子回信后，仍想再让邮筒寄一次“话”，并希望听到邮筒说话的声音。

听着这话，小青蛙笑了，他和蛤蟆奶奶咬了咬耳朵，蛤蟆奶奶连连点头，高高兴兴地回家去了。
知道小青蛙和蛤蟆奶奶说的是什么悄悄话吗？
小青蛙告诉蛤蟆奶奶：“你以后要想让邮筒寄话的话，请预先告诉我，我能让邮筒做好准备，到时只要你和邮筒一说，邮筒就能把你的话寄走……”
page_text_en:
Hearing this, the little frog smiled. He whispered to Grandma Toad, and Grandma Toad nodded happily, then went home.
Do you know what secret the little frog and Grandma Toad were sharing?
The little frog told Grandma Toad: "In the future, if you want to send a message through the mailbox, please tell me in advance. I can get the mailbox ready. Then, as long as you say your message to the mailbox, it will send it away..."
summary_zh: 小青蛙向蛤蟆奶奶解释了如何通过邮筒寄话，并承诺会提前做好准备，让邮筒能顺利传递她的消息。画面中，小青蛙和蛤蟆奶奶在交流，小青蛙显得自信而友好。

不管是寄什么，寄完了，蛤蟆奶奶都去拍拍这个漂亮的绿色邮筒说：“你好棒，又能寄信又能寄话，你是个能干的、还会说话的魔法邮筒！”

So, Grandma Toad sometimes asks the mailbox to send letters, and sometimes, she asks it to send messages.

No matter what she sends, after it's done, Grandma Toad always pats the beautiful green mailbox and says, "You're wonderful! You can send letters and messages. You're a capable, talking magic mailbox!"

summary_zh: 蛤蟆奶奶在寄完信或话后，会拍拍邮筒称赞它是个能干又会说话的魔法邮筒。本页右页显示了下一个故事的标题《母鸡家的房子会咬人》。
